records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government direct the bank
records.summary: Cabo Verde's new Organic Law of the Banco de Cabo Verde, Lei n.º 70/X/2026 of 26 January 2026, published in the Boletim Oficial and in force the day after publication, revokes the 2002 Organic Law and says the Government defines monetary and exchange rate policy. Its preamble says the law sets out the bank's functional autonomy with the unequivocal statement that the Government defines monetary and exchange rate policy with the bank's collaboration, and the law lists among the Board of Administration's competences to collaborate with the Government in defining monetary and exchange rate policy, while the bank executes that policy autonomously. The Governor and Vice-Governor are appointed by resolution of the Council of Ministers on the proposal of the member of Government responsible for finance, the non-executive members of the Supervisory Council by the same route, and the executive administrators by resolution of the Council of Ministers on the Governor's proposal. Article 51 says they cannot be moved and may be dismissed only if they cease to meet the requirements of office or commit serious misconduct, by resolution of the Council of Ministers on the finance minister's proposal, with a right of appeal.
records.source_title: Lei n.º 70/X/2026 de 26 de janeiro — Aprova a Lei Orgânica do Banco de Cabo Verde (Boletim Oficial, I Série nº 8)
records.quote: consagração inequívoca de que o Governo define a política monetária e cambial, com a colaboração do Banco

parties.party: Council of Ministers of Cabo Verde
parties.role: appoints and may dismiss the bank's governor and board members

records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government direct the bank
records.summary: The Statute of the Banca Centrale della Repubblica di San Marino, Law no. 96 of 29 June 2005, in the consolidated text the bank publishes as in force from 30 November 2025, places every seat on the bank's governing bodies in the hands of the state and gives a committee chaired by the finance minister the job of steering the bank's supervisory work. The President and the five Councillors of the Governing Council are appointed by the Consiglio Grande e Generale, San Marino's parliament, and the Director General is appointed by the Governing Council subject to the parliament's approval. Article 48 says the Committee for Credit and Savings is made up of the Secretary of State for Finance, who chairs it, and two to four people the Congress of State appoints from among its own members, and that the Committee is given the function of directing and orienting banking, financial and insurance supervision. The statute does not say the Committee's directions bind the bank, and this record does not claim that they do. This is a standing arrangement with no end date.
records.source_title: Statuto — Legge n. 96 del 29 giugno 2005, testo consolidato in vigore dal 30/11/2025 (Banca Centrale della Repubblica di San Marino)
records.quote: Al Comitato per il Credito e il Risparmio è attribuita la funzione di indirizzo e di orientamento dell’attività di vigilanza bancaria, finanziaria, assicurativa

records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government direct the bank
records.summary: The Central Bank of The Bahamas Act, 2020 (Act No. 24 of 2020), published in the Extraordinary Official Gazette of 27 July 2020, leaves the whole of the bank's board in the finance minister's gift and makes the bank implement exchange rate policy the minister sets. Paragraph 2(1) of the Schedule says the Governor, the two Deputy Governors and six other directors are all appointed by the Governor-General on the advice of the Minister after consultation with the Board, and paragraph 4(3) says a decision to remove a director or Deputy Governor is made by the Governor-General on the advice of the Minister after consultation with the Board. Section 5(1)(f) says the bank's functions include advising the Minister on the exchange rate policy and implementing the exchange rate policy determined by the Minister. The Central Bank of The Bahamas (Amendment) Act, 2023 does not amend section 5 or paragraphs 2 and 4 of the Schedule. This is a standing arrangement with no end date.
records.source_title: Central Bank of The Bahamas Act, 2020 (Act No. 24 of 2020), Extraordinary Official Gazette, 27 July 2020, page 138 (Bahamas Laws On-line)
records.quote: advise the Minister on the exchange rate policy and implement the exchange rate policy determined by the Minister
